components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single bronze action per view, sentence case, with a timber edge on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-wood-600, #7c5032); background: var(--color-wood-400, #b8875a); color: var(--color-ink-950, #0b0a09); font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d4a373; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wood-500, #9b6a43); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-wood-500, #9b6a43); }

components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 360px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-200, #d8d2ca); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(11 10 9 / 0.04); transition: box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1), border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1); } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-ink-400, #958777); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(11 10 9 / 0.08); outline: none; } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wood-500, #9b6a43); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: var(--color-wood-100, #f0e3d4); } .ds-card-body { padding: 24px; } .ds-card-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-wood-600, #7c5032); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Outfit, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.24; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-ink-900, #181614); } .ds-card-text { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--color-ink-600, #5d5349); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Contact form field with a visible timber focus ring and a fix-it error message.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 360px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-ink-800, #2d2925); } .ds-input { min-height: 50px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink-200, #d8d2ca); border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--color-ink-900, #181614); font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-300, #bcb3a7); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-wood-500, #9b6a43); outline: 2px solid var(--color-wood-500, #9b6a43); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-alert-500, #b23c2a); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; padding: 0 16px; min-height: 72px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.92); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(216 210 202 / 0.6); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: var(--color-ink-600, #5d5349); transition: color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-item::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: 10px; height: 1.5px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--color-ink-950, #0b0a09); } .ds-nav-item:hover::after, .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wood-500, #9b6a43); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Lai Huy's interface behaves like a well-run workshop at midday: warm light on linen and sawn timber, tools put away, the work itself on display. Capability is shown, not announced. Photography of real rooms and the factory carries the drama; the interface stays calm, warm and exact around it, the way a finished cabinet face is calm because the joinery behind it is precise.

The page reads as one continuous warm-light surface. Darkness is reserved for two places only: the photographic hero, where an obsidian scrim lets copy sit on the image, and the footer, which closes the page. Sections are separated by small steps in warm tone (linen, raw silk, sawdust) and by hairlines, never by flipping between light and dark. Components feel warm and tactile, like a finished timber surface: soft bronze, gently eased edges, generous padding, nothing glossy.

The system rejects consumer furniture e-commerce, boilerplate construction templates, SaaS product pages and generic AI landing pages. It also rejects alternating light and dark section bands, which the owner found jarring.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous warm-light canvas; dark only for the photo hero and the footer.
Outfit at weight 500 for display and headings, Inter for reading; sentence case throughout.
Bronze is the single accent: the primary action, eyebrow rules, active markers.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and hairlines; shadow only as a response to interaction.
4px edges for anything that holds content, pills for anything you press.
Slow, editorial motion that always yields to `prefers-reduced-motion`.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Bronze is the only accent hue. No second brand color, no gradients between accents, no saturated badges.

rules.name: The Warm Light Rule
rules.body: Body sections sit on linen, raw silk or sawdust. Obsidian surfaces appear only behind the hero photograph and in the footer; a dark band in the middle of a page is drift.

rules.name: The Bronze Edge Rule
rules.body: On light surfaces a bronze-filled button carries a 1px Deep Timber border: bronze alone reaches only about 2.9:1 against linen, under the 3:1 non-text contrast floor.

rules.name: The Vietnamese Leading Rule
rules.body: Any prose at body size or smaller keeps line-height at 1.65 or more; tone marks need the room. This is enforced by the typography gate (T1).

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings and buttons are sentence case. Uppercase is limited to short labels and nav; a heading in continuous uppercase or weight 900 is drift.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only on hover, focus or for floating chrome; glows and deep drop shadows are drift.

dos: Do keep every body section on Linen, Raw Silk or Sawdust, and step between them by tone, not by switching to dark.
Do use Workshop Bronze for the primary action and give it a 1px Deep Timber border on light surfaces.
Do set headings in Outfit 500, sentence case, and keep prose at line-height 1.65 or more.
Do use the 4px edge for content containers and pills for controls.
Do separate content with Plaster Line hairlines at 60% before reaching for a shadow.
Do move with the editorial curve (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1)`), 240ms for hover and 400ms for state, and disable reveal, zoom, Ken Burns, sheen and pulse under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't alternate light and dark section bands; obsidian appears only behind the hero photograph and in the footer.
Don't set headings in Inter 900 or continuous uppercase.
Don't use 16px card or input radii; they belong to the retired interior-page system.
Don't add a second accent hue, gradient text, neon, saturated badges, glassmorphism panels or deep drop shadows.
Don't use bouncing or spring motion, constant looping distractions or heavy parallax.
Don't hardcode hex values in components; use the palette tokens.
